component.name: Proton Drive Desktop
component.summary: Unofficial GTK4 GUI for Proton’s official Drive CLI

description.p: Proton has no official Linux Drive GUI. This unofficial GTK4 / libadwaita app wraps Proton’s official proton-drive CLI so you can browse My files, Photos, Shared with me, and Trash with the same keyring session as the CLI.
It is not affiliated with Proton AG. The Drive product icon is Proton AG artwork from the official Android app (GPL-3.0-or-later).

Rename to proton-drive-desktop. Multi-folder sync pairs, pause/resume, Guided setup, Activity history. Desktop UX parity (DnD, transfer queue, search, breadcrumbs, grid, multi-select, Properties, window memory, notifications). Sync quality (excludes, selective root, preview, direction, systemd timer/path, delta, retry, timeout, seed). GitHub Releases, install.sh, optional AppImage. CLI SHA-512 verify and threat-model docs.

Complete UI translations for Russian, Simplified Chinese, Arabic, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, Korean, and Japanese. Settings language lists each in its native name, persists in gui.json, and restarts the app. Arabic uses a right-to-left GTK layout. Portuguese ships as gettext locale pt.
GNU gettext for the GTK UI with Settings language (System default or English) and an English translation catalog. Changing language restarts the app.
Settings and About show live proton-drive version, including whether Proton reports a newer CLI, with official download and CLI Help links when an update exists.

Always-on folder activity in Settings: live worker running/stopped, last successful pass, files copied last pass, and last error from the niced CLI worker status file. Official proton-drive has no Activity log.
Permanent per-item delete in Trash using proton-drive filesystem delete. Empty trash remains the bulk action.
Photos album create, rename, delete, add photo, and remove photo using the official proton-drive album CLI.
Always-on folder in Settings: enable starts the official CLI download/upload worker and session autostart. Proton Drive CLI 0.8.0 still cannot FUSE-mount Drive.
Local My files folder via official CLI download/upload. Proton Drive CLI 0.8.0 still cannot FUSE-mount Drive.
Rename, copy, move, and empty trash from the UI using the official proton-drive filesystem commands.
Share and invitations from the UI using the official proton-drive sharing and invitation commands.
Official Drive icon, Help and Settings, and Linux install metadata.
